images.filename: Headquarter Of Kalyan Dombivli Muncipal Corporation (cropped).jpg
images.caption: Kalyan-Dombivili is a city and a municipal corporation with its headquarters located in Kalyan in Thane district in the Indian state of Maharashtra. It was formed in 1982 to administer the twin townships of Kalyan and Dombivli. The municipal corporation has a population 1,193,266 (2001 census), and covers 137.15 square km, giving a density of 8,700 people per square km[1] Kalyan has a history 700 years.

images.caption:
Kebun Teh di Kabupaten Malino ini belum terlalu banyak di kenal oleh orang-orang di luar kabupaten malino provinsi sulawesi selatan.
Untuk dapat sampai ke tempat ini cukup menempuh perjalanan kruang lebih 3jam dari pusat kota makassar provinsi sulawesi selatan (indonesia).

Selain dengan keindahan kebun teh, di malino juga banyak terdapat beraneka ragam buah-buahan.
